title: HR24 formal acceptance closeout + G5 evidence reconciliation R1
purpose: Durably record formal human acceptance of the exact JOB26 reviewed/commented/corrected candidate, close the JOB26 human gate, reconcile historical G5 evidence without redundant human replay, and identify the smallest remaining human gate.
invariants: JOB26 RESULT_SHA and JOB26 EVIDENCE_HEAD remain distinct and must never be conflated.
JOB26 formal human validation closes only the JOB26 HUMAN_DECISION_REQUIRED gate and does not imply GO_LIMITED_PILOT or G5 PASS.
No machine assertion may substitute for a human-only G5 observation.
No historical human evidence may be reused after a material later change unless the affected dimension was revalidated.
No product or workflow mutation is authorized.
No real student session is authorized.
PR #468 and PR #466 remain DRAFT / OPEN / UNMERGED.
Issue #427 remains the sole canonical G5 authority.
requiredEvidence: Exact constitutionally anchored UCP/HEAD/UAO/kernel closure verified before governed work.
Exact JOB26 product/evidence identities, qualification run, repository governance run and immutable replay identity revalidated.
Formal human acceptance source is durably recorded without expanding its scope.
Historical G5 protocol, initial human findings, corrective waves, R2 handoffs, R15/learner-journey/HR22/HR23/HR24 evidence and JOB26 replay are reconciled dimension by dimension.
Each G5 dimension records strongest evidence, observed candidate/version, human-vs-machine character, survival across later material changes and governed disposition.
Any remaining replay protocol contains only insufficient or superseded human dimensions and reuses the existing immutable JOB26 replay where possible.
Repository governance passes on the final JOB27 evidence-only head.
adversarialTests: Fail if JOB26 formal acceptance is ignored or a complete JOB26 replay is requested again.
Fail if JOB26 acceptance is converted into GO_LIMITED_PILOT, G5 PASS, merge, promotion or student-session authorization.
Fail if screen-reader, keyboard-only, touch, full-journey or pilot-confidence evidence is invented from automation.
Fail if superseded human evidence is treated as current after later material UX changes.
Fail if HR24-003 is declared resolved or non-blocking without explicit human authority.
Fail if any path outside the exact allowlist changes.
Fail if any product/workflow byte changes.
Fail if #427 is replaced as G5 authority or #428/WP045 history is rewritten.
nonGoals: Modify product, workflow, architecture, scoring, ActivityResponse, objective semantics, recommendation semantics, authored content or Atlas engine behavior.
Redo dimensions already sufficiently proven by current human evidence.
Merge or promote any pull request.
Start or authorize real student sessions.
rollback: Close the unmerged JOB27 pull request and delete branch student-v01/g5-evidence-reconciliation-r1. No product rollback is required because JOB27 is evidence-only.
independentReview: Revalidate exact JOB26 RESULT_SHA, EVIDENCE_HEAD, qualification/repository-governance runs and immutable replay identity independently of chat claims.
Challenge every G5 matrix row against the canonical JOB09 human-only protocol; machine evidence must never be promoted to a human PASS.
Verify that historical human evidence marked current actually survived later material changes; otherwise require only the affected delta dimension.
Compare the JOB27 PR diff to the exact allowlist and confirm zero product/workflow mutation, zero merge/promotion and zero student-session authorization.
